notes.title: 1.5 Version
notes.notes:
1. Updated DLC: Girls' Dormitory. You can enter the DLC in the upper right corner of the game start scene. This chapter is an independent puzzle game with high difficulty. Please make good use of all objects in the scene!
2. Fixed bugs
1.更新DLC：女生宿舍。在游戏开始界面的右上角可以进入DLC游玩。该章节为独立的解谜游戏，难度很高，请利用好场景里的一切物体！
2.修复bug

notes.title: Update Notes (2024/12/29)
notes.notes:
1. Added difficulty selection, which can be set on the start interface
2. Chapter 3 can now be played directly

1.可在开始界面选择难度
2.第三章现在可直接游玩
